name: Raspberry, Hibiscus & Rose
desc: Raspberries with ruby hibiscus and a trace of fragrant culinary rose.
ing: 160 ml chilled unsweetened hibiscus infusion, cold-brewed in the fridge
Water, as needed to reach 800–850 ml TOTAL contents (not extra)
method: Wash fruit and herbs, remove any stones or other inedible parts. Use only food-grade culinary flowers, rosewater and botanical ingredients.
Put all ingredients in the soup-maker jug, adding chilled water only until the combined contents measure 800–850 ml. Observe both the 800 ml MIN and 1,000 ml MAX marks.
Use the UNHEATED Drinks/Blend programme for approximately 2 minutes; never heat a smoothie.
Taste before adding additional florals; fragrance should enhance the fruit rather than overwhelm it. Serve promptly.
science: Fruit provides fibre and polyphenols; floral additions are for aroma, not unproven health claims.
note: Project 400 · Botanical, herbal & floral · £££ · Spring · Untested idea. Use very small amounts of food-grade florals. ID P400-083.
